thread:
maya: heads up — saw a bunch of duplicate billing events in invoice-preview for priority routes during the 17:02 outage window. Looks like fallback/circuit-breaker path retried and emitted meter events twice.
leo: ugh, any sample trace ids?
maya: yep, triage logs: ```2026-03-18T17:02:12Z tenant=acme req_id=rt-9e5f emitBillingEvent status=ok attempt=1
2026-03-18T17:02:12Z tenant=acme req_id=rt-9e5f emitBillingEvent status=ok attempt=2```
leo: that attempt=2 is from the fallback path? could be replaying same token count
sanjay: we saw circuit-breaker trip and the router rerouted to fallback pool which doesn't share the same dedupe key
olivia: console shows +0.8% invoice preview delta for a handful of tenants. Not huge but visible
maya: theory: fallback path uses `request_id` arg, but our fingerprint for metering is `edge_session` only. So duplicates when router replays with a new edge_session
leo: propose: extend fingerprint to include `originating_request_id` and `model_alias` — low-risk upgrade to dedupe window
sanjay: downside: some older clients don't send `originating_request_id`
olivia: can we backfill by matching k/v cache prefix? probably not reliable
ingest-bot: alert: metering-ingest duplicated_events_rate spiked 4x at 17:02:10-17:03:00
maya: immediate mitigation: shorten dedupe window from 60s->5s for priority routes (limits double-count window) and add a transient suppress in router for replays
leo: that's risky if legitimate retries arrive slightly later. maybe do canary: route tag `priority-dedupe-v2` applied to 5% traffic
sanjay: agree on canary. I'll add a feature flag and a sampling rule. Also will instrument new fingerprint metric: `metering.fingerprint_match_ratio`
olivia: UX: console should flag preview diffs coming from dedupe algorithm changes. Add an annotation to invoice-preview when dedupe-mode != observed-mode
maya: +1 on annotation. Also capture samples of duplicated payloads for a 24h window for audits
oncall-bot: scheduled runbook task created: /runbooks/metering/dupe-audit assigned to sanjay
leo: action items: 1) sanjay: rollout canary + metrics 2) maya: collect dup samples 3) olivia: add console annotation 4) leo: follow-up in 2h
sanjay: starting canary now, will post logs. ping me for quick rollback
maya: thanks — keeping an eye on invoice-preview and routing logs :thumbsup:
